gloss: to re-cover; to replace (paper, fabric); to re-paper

definitions.gloss: to re-cover; to replace a stretched surface (paper, fabric, leather)
definitions.explanation: To remove an existing paper, cloth, leather, or screen surface and replace it with a fresh one. Common with shoji screens, wallpaper, sofa upholstery, and tatami covers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{障子|しょうじ}→障子：04201_shouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{替|か}える。
⟦{壁紙|かべがみ}→壁紙：16077_kabegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{張|は}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: We re-papered the walls in white.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{替|か}えて⟦もらったら→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When I had the cover of the old sofa replaced, it looked like new.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to stretch, to put up) + ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (to exchange, to replace).

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The surface being replaced is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧; the new material with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{障子|しょうじ}→障子：04201_shouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{替|か}える: re-paper a shoji screen
- ⟦{壁紙|かべがみ}→壁紙：16077_kabegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{替|か}える: re-paper the walls
- ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{替|か}える: replace the cover of tatami mats
- ⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{替|か}える: re-cover a sofa

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {貼|は}り{替|か}える: replace something pasted (a sticker, poster) — uses the kanji {貼|は} for sticking
- ⟦{取|と}り{替|か}える→取り替える：01252_torikaeru⟧: to swap; replace (general) — does not imply a stretched surface

NOTE: {張|は}り{替|か}える and {貼|は}り{替|か}える are often confused; for shoji, wallpaper, and tatami, {張|は}り{替|か}える is conventional.
